eligibility: 18-70 years old, 110+ lbs, good health; valid photo ID, proof of SSN, proof of current address (within 60 days); pass medical screening; twice weekly max with at least 2 days between donations; 7-day wait when switching centers
steps: Find an Octapharma Plasma center (170+ US locations) and schedule online
Bring valid photo ID, proof of SSN, and proof of current address
Pass screening and physical exam on first visit (~2 hours)
Complete donations within the first 35 days to capture the new-donor payments
Compensation loads to prepaid debit card within 24 hours of each donation
catches: New-donor payments only apply within the first 35 days — after that you drop to regular rates.

biggest_catch: The '$750 in 35 days' is a promotional window — ongoing per-visit pay is $50-$100, and rates can change without notice.

repeatable.cadence: Up to twice per week with at least 2 full days between donations, indefinitely, as long as you keep passing screening — the elevated first-35-day new-donor pay is one-time per person.
repeatable.note: Ongoing: up to twice per week indefinitely at regular per-visit pay. New-donor first-35-day payments are one-time per person.

maximize: Cram the new-donor donations into the first 35 days — that's where the elevated pay lives. Keep a steady twice-a-week rhythm (Mon/Thu or Tue/Fri) with the required 2-day gap. Join OctaRewards in the OctaApp to stack loyalty points on top of donation pay, and ask about friend-referral payouts before you bring anyone.

who_pays: Octapharma Plasma loads your compensation onto a prepaid debit card after each successful donation.
who_qualifies: You must be 18-70 years old, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and bring a valid photo ID, proof of SSN, and proof of current address — then pass the medical screening. There is also a 7-day wait if you are switching from another company's center. Every visit re-screens you; failing means no donation and no pay.
work_available: Octapharma operates 170+ US centers — normally open and operating. The $750 new-donor promo pays out within your first 35 days, but official terms say rates "may vary by location and change without notice," so confirm your center's current offer before starting.
what_gets_accepted: A completed, successful donation — pass the health screening and finish the donation. A deferral at screening or an incomplete donation means no pay.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit takes about 2 hours with registration, screening, and physical before any pay. Return visits run about 90-180 minutes. At least 2 full days must separate donations. It's a needle in your arm plus travel and waiting time — none of the screening or waiting is paid.
when_cash_arrives: Compensation is loaded onto your prepaid debit card within 24 hours of each successful donation.
